When both SubId and QueryId are provided, AMPS removes all
matching subscriptions and SOW queries.
This command requires at least one of the SubId or QueryId fields to be
set.

Acknowledgment type for the given command.
Value is a comma separated list of one or more of the following: none,
received or persisted.

If specified within an AMPS command requesting an acknowledgment
message, all requested acknowledgment messages will contain the
CommandId in the ack response header.
